3125.title: Native safe-area values do not reach panel layout
3125.rootCauseOneLine: The native shell injects explicit safe-area insets, but the bridge never publishes them to CSS while the compact panel relies only on a zero-valued WebKit env inset.
3125.proposedFix: Publish handshake and rotation insets as root native-safe-area CSS variables, then make the compact shelf prefer them with WebKit env fallbacks.
3125.caveats: The TestFlight binary was unavailable; two clean trusted web builds reproduced the native-bridge geometry with the same 59px handshake.
